column1: # The value this mod patches, one line per property:
# FILE is the MBIN path the game uses, relative to the data root.
# PROPERTY is the field to rewrite.
# BASE is the value the game ships today.
# VALUE is the value the mod puts there.
# The render step turns this table into the Lua patch block and into the
# expected values that make verify checks the built EXML against, so a
# value can never be patched without also being checked, and the two can
# BootDirectlyIntoLastSave is the game's own startup shortcut: when true,
# boot goes straight into the most recently played save instead of
# stopping at the Main Menu. It lives in the debug options global, next
# to the other boot flags (SkipIntro, SkipLogos, FastLoad).
